title: Work items list v2
description: Body of GET /api/work?view=list: one keyset page of work-list-item, at most 25 per page, optionally filtered by state or by a bot's bindingId. order says how the page is sorted and is the order the request asked for (created when the request named none): created is createdAtMs newest first and updated is updatedAtMs newest first, each with workId descending as the tie-break. nextCursor is an opaque cursor for the next page of the same order, or null on the last page; a cursor made for the other order, or taken from work-items v1, is refused with invalid_cursor. A page is read at one instant, but pages are read one after another: in updated order an item changed between two page reads moves to the head, so a later page can show it a second time or miss one item until the next read of the first page, which a poller repeats. It repeats the contractVersion, items and nextCursor members of page.v1 with a typed item, because a closed schema cannot be composed with allOf. GET /api/work without view still returns work-items v1 unchanged. asOfMs is the server time the page was read.
